specs.title: Where spec stores specs
specs.description: docs: files under docs/specs. issues: GitHub issues. both: a file plus a linked issue. Not sure? Keep docs.

ship.title: How ship finishes a run
ship.description: ask: ship puts the question. pr-merge: open a pull request and merge it once checks pass. open-pr: open a pull request and stop. push: push the branch. local: keep the commits on this machine. Not sure? Keep ask.
